headline: 3 jailed after midnight rampage in Dhaka targets housing project and studio
summary: Attackers fired 50 rounds of gunfire and looted valuables worth Tk 29 million from New Gini Properties and Salman Muqtadir's studio.
details: A Dhaka court has sent three people to jail following their arrest for vandalism, looting, and theft at the New Gini Properties housing project in South Manikdi.
The attack occurred around 10:30 pm on Saturday, where approximately 50 attackers trespassed onto the project site, firing around 50 rounds of gunfire and using machetes, daggers, and sticks.

The group targeted the project office and a studio named 'Brownfish' belonging to content creator Salman Muqtadir, vandalising the premises and looting professional media equipment, laptops, and cash.
New Gini Properties authority claimed that the vandalism and looting resulted in damage worth around Tk 14 million and the theft of property worth around Tk 15 million.
Several people, including site engineer Md Parvez, sustained severe injuries during the assault.
Police from Cantonment Police Station responded to the scene, where the attackers opened fire on them. Officers responded by firing five shotgun rounds in self-defence to control the situation.
Three suspects, Md Mamun, Md Aslam, and Md Munna, were arrested and produced in court on Sunday. Local weapons and spent bullet casings were recovered from them.
The attack is believed to have stemmed from a land dispute between a property developer and a retired military officer.
caption:
50 rounds of gunfire and Tk 29 million in losses. A midnight rampage in Dhaka left a housing project and a content creator's studio in ruins.

A Dhaka court has sent three people to jail following their arrest for vandalism, looting, and theft at the New Gini Properties housing project in South Manikdi.

The attack occurred around 10:30 pm on Saturday, where approximately 50 attackers trespassed onto the project site, firing around 50 rounds of gunfire and using machetes, daggers, and sticks.

The group targeted the project office and a studio named 'Brownfish' belonging to content creator Salman Muqtadir, vandalising the premises and looting professional media equipment, laptops, and cash.

New Gini Properties authority claimed that the vandalism and looting resulted in damage worth around Tk 14 million and the theft of property worth around Tk 15 million.

Several people, including site engineer Md Parvez, sustained severe injuries during the assault.

Police from Cantonment Police Station responded to the scene, where the attackers opened fire on them. Officers responded by firing five shotgun rounds in self-defence to control the situation.

Three suspects, Md Mamun, Md Aslam, and Md Munna, were arrested and produced in court on Sunday. Local weapons and spent bullet casings were recovered from them.

The attack is believed to have stemmed from a land dispute between a property developer and a retired military officer.

headline_marked: Accused [[prisoner escapes from prison van]] on way to Kashimpur Jail
headline: Accused prisoner escapes from prison van on way to Kashimpur Jail
summary: Raja alias Pichchi Raja, an accused in an explosives case, fled after requesting a restroom break during transport from a Dhaka court to Gazipur.
details: Raja alias Pichchi Raja, 30, escaped from a prison van on Sunday evening around 8:30 pm near the Baimail Moyalar Bagar area on the Dhaka-Tangail Highway in Gazipur city.
The escape occurred while 30 accused inmates were being transported back to Kashimpur Central Jail-1 from the Dhaka Metropolitan Court following court proceedings and hearings.
According to police, Raja started shouting that he needed to use a restroom. An SI accompanying the inmates took him down from the vehicle to facilitate the request.
Once outside the vehicle, Raja allegedly managed to flee by running away from the officers.
Mohammad Taherul Haque Chowhan, acting commissioner of Gazipur Metropolitan Police, confirmed the incident and stated that authorities are currently looking into the matter.
caption:
A prisoner requested a restroom break and then vanished. How did he manage to escape from a prison van?

Raja alias Pichchi Raja, 30, escaped from a prison van on Sunday evening around 8:30 pm near the Baimail Moyalar Bagar area on the Dhaka-Tangail Highway in Gazipur city.

The escape occurred while 30 accused inmates were being transported back to Kashimpur Central Jail-1 from the Dhaka Metropolitan Court following court proceedings and hearings.

According to police, Raja started shouting that he needed to use a restroom. An SI accompanying the inmates took him down from the vehicle to facilitate the request.

Once outside the vehicle, Raja allegedly managed to flee by running away from the officers.

Mohammad Taherul Haque Chowhan, acting commissioner of Gazipur Metropolitan Police, confirmed the incident and stated that authorities are currently looking into the matter.
